flagged.comment: Building Finished Floor Elevations (FFE) are inconsistent across sheets. Sheet 9 lists Bldg 1 FFE as 687.50, Bldg 3 as 685.50, and Bldg 4 as 685.50. Sheet 30 lists Bldg 1 FFE as 688.50, Bldg 3 as 688.0, and Bldg 4 as 685.0. Technical design data must be identical across all occurrences. Update the Existing Tree Plan (Sheet 30) to match the authoritative values shown on the Site Plan (Sheet 9).

Building finished floor elevations are inconsistent across sheets: Building 1 shown as FFE 687.50 on Sheet 29 but 688.50 on Sheet 30 (0.50-ft difference); Building 3 shown as FFE 685.50 on Sheet 29 but 688.0 on Sheet 30 (2.50-ft difference). Conflicts must be reconciled and authoritative sheet identified.

Sheet 30 contains a cross-reference note stating 'REFER SHEET 28 FOR TREE LIST,' but Sheet 28 contains Construction Details 7 (storm drain manholes and catch basins). The Tree List is located on Sheet 32. Incorrect sheet number must be corrected to reference Sheet 32.

Sheet 23 contains duplicate fire hydrant installation notes appearing in both Block 7 and Block 9, with identical content. Duplicate construction details must be consolidated into a single authoritative instance and removed from secondary locations.

Sheets 23-27 contain construction details for Austin Water utility infrastructure (water, wastewater, fire service). The requirement under UCM 2.5.1.E.20 states that Austin Water standard detail drawings must appear on dedicated AW detail sheets and not be mixed with details from other departments. Available documentation does not provide sufficient detail to confirm whether these sheets contain only AW utility standards or if they mix AW standards with non-AW department standards (e.g., DPD or other city departments). Visual inspection of the actual sheets is required to verify compliance.

The Texas 811 'Call Before You Dig' utility notification logo appears on both Sheet 3 (General Notes) and Sheet 9 (Site Plan). Per ZLU-4.33, this logo should appear once only on the most appropriate primary reference sheet. Remove the logo from one of these sheets to comply.

The Austin Water General Notes sheet contains required fields that are left blank. Specifically, the Address field in the Meter Notice Potable Meter(s) section is blank for both the 6" Combination Potable Domestic & Fire meter and the 3/4" Irrigation meter. Complete all required fields in the Meter Notice section per current Austin Water standards.
